##### Project general facts

Creek Beach Orchid is considered a true urban oasis haven. The complex is just steps away from the picturesque Creek Beach and the world's largest artificial lagoon. This unique atmosphere allows residents to enjoy the beach and water activities right next to their homes. 

Here, residents can indulge in a wealth of restaurants, shops, and entertainment venues that line the lively waterfront promenade. Public parks create the perfect setting for neighborly gatherings, outdoor business meetings, and casual conversations.

##### Location description and benefits

Emaar has chosen Creek Beach as the prime location for Creek Beach Orchid to offer an unforgettable opportunity for those looking for the perfect family vacation destination, a place where they can easily get anywhere they want to go.

The first of its kind in the city, Creek Beach Orchid is located in the heart of Dubai Creek Harbour. The homes are located next to the well-known Dubai Creek. The aim of the project is to give you the best family vacation experience. With 700 meters of perfect white dunes, an infinity pool and breathtaking sunset views, these residences are a paradise reborn.

Orchid is located in a vibrant, family-oriented city with a diverse selection of restaurants, stores, recreational facilities and entertainment just steps away.
